Whispy documentation

Whispy is a private voice dictation app for macOS and Linux (X11). Hold a key, speak, release, and your words are typed into the active app.

Everything runs on your machine with the NVIDIA Parakeet model, so no audio or text ever leaves your computer.

Install

One command, then a short per-OS checklist for permissions and dependencies.

Troubleshooting

Pick a symptom and follow it to the fix, matched to make doctor.

Configuration

Build a config.json, see what every key accepts, and watch how chunking works.

Usage

Trigger modes, the local HTTP API, logs, restarting, uninstalling, and FAQ.

The page shows the steps for your operating system. Use the macOS / Linux switch at the top to change it.
